consensus_summary: Seven source findings are retained in immutable EIC-to-R1-to-R2-to-R3-to-DA traceability through four non-ranking REV items. REV-01 preserves EIC-W1, R1-W1, and the DA bounded Minor finding as three source records of one replay-order defect. REV-03 preserves R3-W1 and R3-W3 as distinct but compatible Route-interface findings. R2 records no weakness; no finding reaches CONSENSUS-3 or CONSENSUS-4; no explicit non-DA dispute creates a SPLIT; and the DA CRITICAL and MAJOR tables are empty. The full P28 tuple remains unassigned, the historical (A0_WEAK_ARITHMETIC_RELATION,A1_WEAK,A2_FAIL,A3_FAIL,A4_FAIL) proxy remains historical and unpromoted, the exact systole and cutoff remain A0--A1 control infrastructure only, 144 remains an equality-achieving element count, and matched census, magnetic comparison, A2/A3/A4, determinant, spectral, and Route-B work remains not run.
dissenting_opinions: R1 passes D3 because the geometric completeness theorem connects exact finite execution to the global systole claim, while DA warns D3 for a bounded replay-sequencing ambiguity; the D3 F3 majority predicate remains false at one of two eligible seats.

EIC assesses the completed theorem-and-certificate package as a coherent field-general contribution, while R3 warns that the object interfaces and downstream falsification chain remain under-explained; this is a difference between D6 contribution evidence and D4 accessibility, not a venue-fit or Route-promotion finding.
